name: weight-written-breakout-v2-full-flight
reason: Brick interval survives longer but often retraces empty paths; brick old wastes early prediction by returning to center within upper rows. Extend prediction across those rows, prefer old-x contact for non-retracing bounces, and optionally accept the full safe interval only at the final catch step.
selection: highest mean reward across the same 128 development seeds; break ties in candidate order
constraint: unchanged 400-794-3 architecture, raw observations, no gradients or fitted weights
information_boundary: development inspected; heldout and stress unseen
